description: the Agent SDK audit script ships and is valid JS (node can parse and run it)
command: node --check labs/m10/audit-sdk.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail

description: the SDK fan-out audits all four modules and joins into one normalized report (same partition as the shell workflow)
the SDK report labels its orchestration style — this is the Agent SDK expression of the workflow, distinct from the shell version
EQUIVALENCE: the SDK fan-out and the shell workflow produce the IDENTICAL estate evidence and verdict — same orchestration shape, two implementations
command: a=$(node labs/m10/audit-sdk.mjs | jq -S '{modules_audited,total_security_findings,total_cost_delta_usd,verdict,evidence}'); b=$(scripts/audit-orchestrate.sh | jq -S '{modules_audited,total_security_findings,total_cost_delta_usd,verdict,evidence}'); [ "$a" = "$b" ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: RUNAWAY CONTROL: the SDK semaphore caps in-flight workers, and the answer is identical at --max-parallel 1 and 4 — concurrency changes speed, never the result
command: a=$(node labs/m10/audit-sdk.mjs --max-parallel 1 | jq -S 'del(.max_parallel)'); b=$(node labs/m10/audit-sdk.mjs --max-parallel 4 | jq -S 'del(.max_parallel)'); [ "$a" = "$b" ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: DUPLICATION GUARD: the SDK partition rejects a repeated module (exit 1), same contract as the shell workflow — one module, one worker
command: node labs/m10/audit-sdk.mjs --modules 'networking networking' >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 1 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: FAIL-CLOSED: the SDK fan-out over a nonexistent module blocks (exit 1) rather than auditing a phantom partition
command: node labs/m10/audit-sdk.mjs --modules 'networking phantom' >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 1 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: FAIL-CLOSED: a concurrency cap below 1 is rejected (exit 1) — an SDK fan-out with zero workers is a misconfiguration
command: node labs/m10/audit-sdk.mjs --max-parallel 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 1 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: FAIL-CLOSED: --live without the SDK installed blocks (exit 1) with a clear message rather than silently falling back — the live worker is a real agent or nothing
command: node labs/m10/audit-sdk.mjs --live >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 1 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: the live SDK worker is provisioned like an M9 role bundle: a read-only tool set (no write tool) and a turn budget (maxTurns) — orchestration inherits the role boundaries
command: grep -q 'allowedTools' labs/m10/audit-sdk.mjs && grep -q 'maxTurns' labs/m10/audit-sdk.mjs && ! grep -Eq 'allowedTools.*"(Edit|Write)"' labs/m10/audit-sdk.mjs && echo pass || echo fail
